card.name: Immune cell and cytokine names, mid-term
card.fires_on: Partway through immunology terms, such as the B in B cells, granulocyte-macrophage, tumor necrosis, PD-L1, and the CTLA-4 pathway, often just before the next piece of the term. It also fires on some digits inside numbers.

modes.label: Immune term in progress
modes.description: Marks the spot inside or just before an immune cell, cytokine or checkpoint name.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: Fires on a digit within a dose, count or section number.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing terms like colony-stimulating factor, and away from words like mature or secretion.
